## Quarto

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

mental_health <- summary_data %>%
  filter(
    Indicator ==
      "MENTAL HEALTH and WELLBEING - Level of psychological distress",
    Variables ==
      "High / very high (K10 22+)"
  ) %>%
  select(
    LGA,
    distress_pct = `%...4`
  )

food_poverty <- summary_data %>%
  filter(
    Indicator ==
      "POVERTY - Ran out of money to buy food in last 12 months",
    Variables ==
      "Ran out of money to buy food in last 12 months"
  ) %>%
  select(
    LGA,
    poverty_pct = `%...4`
  )

analysis_data <- left_join(
  mental_health,
  food_poverty,
  by = "LGA"
)

head(analysis_data)
```

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
